name: Agent Step Timeline
hint: Watch the sample run: the rail draws to each step as it lands, then stops at a gate for the refund. Approve or reject it, or press Stop.
description: A live agent run you can see and steer, drawn from the caller's steps. Each step has a kind (reasoning, tool call, approval, reply) and shows its AI SDK state (input-streaming, input-available, approval-requested, approval-responded, output-available, output-error) as an icon and a label. The rail draws from one step to the next as each settles; the running step carries a live elapsed timer (from the caller's own timestamps) and an arc that fills with real progress where the tool reports it. Reasoning streams open and folds to a one-line summary on a measured spring shortly after it finishes, unless you pin it. Tool calls open to formatted input and output with copy buttons, long output clamped behind Show all, and nested sub-steps with their own short rail. Anything with consequences stops the rail at a gate and states exactly what will happen, with Approve, Reject and an optional 'always allow' box; focus moves to it without stealing it from a field you are typing in, and it is announced once. Failed tools show the reason and Retry, Stop works at any time and marks where the run stopped, and a finished run folds into one summary line that opens again without re-mounting. Nothing runs on its own: the caller passes steps and status. The gallery's sample (an operations agent refunding an order) plays only with `demo`.
intents: show an AI agent's steps and tool calls live
agent asks for approval before a risky action
tool call timeline with input and output
human in the loop approve or reject agent action
collapsible reasoning and chain of thought steps
usage: Use in an agent or copilot panel to show a run while it happens. Drive it from your stream by passing `steps` (newest last, each with a stable `id`) and, optionally, `status` (running, waiting, finished, stopped, error, idle; derived from the steps when left out). A step is { id, kind: "reasoning" | "tool" | "approval" | "message", title, state (AI SDK) or status (pending, streaming, running, waiting, done, error, stopped, approved, rejected), tool, input, output, summary, error, detail (a React node shown in the step's body), progress: { value, total, unit }, startedAt, endedAt, requestedAt, respondedAt (epoch ms), decision, always, children }. Map AI SDK tool parts straight across: part.state becomes `state`, part.input and part.output become `input` and `output`; reasoning parts are kind reasoning with the text so far in `output`. Approval steps take `approval: { action, details: [[label, value]], note, eyebrow, approveLabel, rejectLabel, alwaysLabel }`. Wire `onApprove(id, { always, step })`, `onReject(id, { step })`, `onRetry(id, { step })` and `onStop({ step, status })` to your agent, then update the step's state yourself; set `busy` while your call is in flight so nothing fires twice. Which steps are open is yours with `expanded` (step ids) + `onExpandedChange(ids, { id, open, step })`, or starts from `defaultExpanded`; otherwise steps open while they work and fold after. The summary-line collapse is `collapsed` + `onCollapsedChange` (or `defaultCollapsed`). `task`, `agent` ({ name, org, by }) and `mark` (a node) fill the header; `labels` replaces any word of the chrome. The ref is the root <section>. Nothing runs by itself: no steps shows the empty state. `demo` plays a scripted sample run (only when no `steps` are passed); `script` replaces its copy.

dataProps.description: The run, newest last. Each step: { id (stable), kind: 'reasoning' | 'tool' | 'approval' | 'message', title, state (AI SDK: input-streaming, input-available, approval-requested, approval-responded, output-available, output-error) or status in plain words (pending, streaming, running, waiting, done, error, stopped, approved, rejected), tool, input, output, summary (the folded one-liner), error, errorDetail, detail (ReactNode for the body), progress: { value, total, unit }, startedAt, endedAt, requestedAt, respondedAt (epoch ms; timers show only when startedAt is set), stopped, decision: 'approved' | 'rejected', always, approval, children (sub-steps of the same shape) }. Leave out for the empty state.
The run's status in the header pill and summary line. Left out, it is derived from the steps (an approval-requested step means waiting, an error step error, all settled finished).
The task the agent was given, as the header title. Blank shows no title.
Who is running: shown under the title ('name · org · asked by by') and used in announcements and the approval eyebrow ('name wants to'). Left out: no by-line, and 'Agent' / 'the agent' in sentences.
A small logo or avatar at the start of the header. Left out: none.
Ids of the open steps, controlled (pass with onExpandedChange). Message steps are always open.
Ids of steps that start open when uncontrolled; the rest open while they work and fold after.
A step was opened or closed: the whole next list of open ids, and which step changed.
Starting collapse of the step list into the summary line, when uncontrolled.
The person pressed Show steps / Hide steps. With `collapsed` (and no defaultCollapsed) the collapse is controlled. A waiting approval always keeps the list open.

Replace any word of the chrome: running, waiting, finished, stopped, error, idle (pill), stop, retry, replay, showSteps, hideSteps, emptyTitle, emptyBody, approve, reject (default button labels), approvedBy, rejectedBy, stoppedBy, input, output, reasoning, reply, and state: (step, text) => string to rewrite the state label under each title.
The caller's call is in flight (after Approve, Reject, Retry or Stop): those controls are disabled so nothing fires twice, and the root is aria-busy. Set and clear it yourself.
Approve pressed on a waiting approval step. `always` is the 'always allow' box. Then set that step's state to approval-responded (decision 'approved') and carry on.
Reject pressed on a waiting approval step.
Retry pressed on a failed step (state output-error, not stopped).
Stop pressed while the run is live; `step` is the running step (or the last one). Mark the stopped step with stopped: true and set status 'stopped'.
Copy of the scripted sample run that `demo` plays (see DEFAULT_SCRIPT in the source). Only used with demo.
The root <section> (role region, named by the task). ref.current.scrollIntoView() or measure it.
Plays the scripted sample run (an operations agent refunding an order) with its task, agent and mark, when no `steps` are passed. For the gallery; leave off in real use.
